evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Directive establishes a recurring future cadence and frames the unrehearsed case as a hypothetical principle about what one actually possesses.
Compressed noun phrase names a specific recurring practice scheduled ahead, carrying future-irrealis attention on a concrete artifact.
Name-only identification anchors present attention on a specific person in the actual here-and-now.
